svg.title: Forge UGC — Avatar Graphics
svg.desc: Measured native vector reconstruction of the newly generated Avatar Graphics screen. Illustrated media are individually traced sample placeholders; labels and controls remain editable. The unsupported download icon controls in the initial image are omitted; Copy link gives access to full resolution. Prices, job progress, avatar and gallery images are replaceable live-data placeholders.
svg.text: Turn your look into something shareable.
A neon poster of my avatar, electric blue lighting...
Creating your avatar graphic. This may take a few seconds.
